Olivia: Heads-up  FluxScale sent invoice FS-2026-02 showing pilot Feb + renewal Mar billed together. Link: https://fluxscale.example/invoices/FS-2026-02
Priya: Can you paste the line items and PO? cc finance + procurement.
Olivia: Lines:
``` 
Item: FluxScale Pilot Feb 2026 - $9,100
Item: FluxScale Renewal Mar 2026 - $14,600
Tax: $0
Total: $23,700
PO: PO-121314
Contract: CT-2025-FS
```
Ben: Feb spike was our load test (job: load-early-2). Not production. I'll attach the run logs to the ticket. Finance prefers credit notes over refunds for small disputes.
billing-bot: Invoice FS-2026-02 uploaded: https://files.redwood/invoices/FS-2026-02.pdf :page_facing_up:
procurement-bot: Ticket TKT-7017 created "FluxScale double-charge + pricing model ask" assigned to Priya. SLA 72h.
Priya: Proposed asks to vendor: (A) credit the pilot amount $9,100 OR issue a credit note for that amount, (B) switch billing to consolidated quarterly cycles (payments 1st of quarter) starting 2026-05-01, (C) pilot a pooled prepaid credits model for 30 days at a 7% discount vs per-usage billing to smooth spikes. Which option does finance prefer?
Ben: Finance likes credit note + quarterly cadence. The prepaid pooled credits trial needs a forecast to evaluate revenue-recog impact. If vendor can price a 30-day pool, we can trial it for benchmark windows. Also require GL mapping for the credit note.
Olivia: I'll attach the benchmark logs and a 12-week forecast for the prepaid pool scenario.
VendorRep: Thanks, we can issue a credit note for the pilot once we receive the run logs + PO. We can also offer a 30-day prepaid pool at a 7% discount, billable at contract amendment. Need written acceptance from procurement + legal for the trial.
Priya: @Rachel (legal) please pre-review a short amendment: quarterly billing cadence + prepaid-pool trial terms (30 days, trial price, measurement window, opt-out). Procurement will accept credit note in lieu of refund if legal signs.
Rachel: Will draft amendment template and redline by EOD. Include contract ref CT-2025-FS and proposed effective date 2026-05-01.
Priya: Action items: Olivia upload logs + forecast to TKT-7017, VendorRep to confirm prepaid pool price, Rachel to draft amendment, Ben to confirm GL code and AP hold thresholds. Target close Apr 20 to avoid month-end recon. Owners: @Priya (procurement), @Ben (finance), @Olivia (usage evidence).
Olivia: Uploaded everything to the ticket. Ping me if vendor asks for additional docs. :pray:
